scenario_definition.one_shot_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. The location is in Turin.
scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an existing school building to create a spring section (sezione primavera) for 14 children, integrated into an existing kindergarten in Turin with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an existing school building.
clarifications.D: I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten.
Cb: A dedicated indoor section adequate for a small bridge cohort of children aged 24 to 36 months, without exact gross area metrics ready.
I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people.
Ce: A healthy indoor thermal environment that avoids drafts and high heating costs, without a predetermined certification grade.
I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
clarifications.Cp: I have no requirement on proximity to public transport.

evaluation_results.evaluation_text: This 535.56 sqm property is listed for schools and educational activities and was built in 2020, making it a strong candidate for consideration as an existing school building to integrate with a kindergarten. The high location score (94) and strong proximity indicators—including education (92.3), green areas (93.38), and healthcare (91.42)—support its strategic appeal in Turin. Its A1 energy class and strong envelope score are additional strengths, although the supplied data do not establish room layout, authorization, or suitability for the intended use. The cited regional standard specifies 6 sqm of net useful area per child across designated rooms and facilities, with a capacity of 6–20 children; this is not a minimum gross property area. The section must be integrated into a qualifying host facility, and applicable rules should be confirmed at the time of application, including the transition to D.G.R. 3-1937/2025.
pros: Existing school and educational use, with a recent 2020 construction period, aligns with the objective of finding a school building.
Substantial listed area of 535.56 sqm provides a promising basis for assessing a spring section, though room layout and usable areas remain to be verified.

Strong location and service access, reflected in a location score of 94 and high education, green-area, healthcare, and mobility indicators; the A1 energy class and envelope score of 5 add further strengths.
cons: The property data do not establish the net useful areas or room layout needed to assess the 6 sqm per child standard across the specified functions or the 6–20 child capacity range.

Compatibility with the intended use, the status of an eligible host kindergarten, and authorization are unverified; urban-planning, building-use, health, accessibility, fire-safety where required, structural, seismic, and sector authorization checks remain necessary.
The energy plant and renewables scores are both 1, indicating weaknesses in those recorded energy components despite the A1 class and envelope score of 5.
